scope: Three samples per lane on a shared host. Measured processes use CPUs 4-7 and a 16 GiB memory limit; Docker providers are unrestricted. Local scale uses the Dev profile, excluding automatic retained history. Not dedicated-runner or external-provider qualification.

definitions.elapsed_scope: Existing client workload elapsed; excludes gateway readiness/setup. Paired runner wall-clock overhead is separate.
definitions.rss: gateway_process.vm_hwm_bytes is sampled process high-water RSS; vm_rss_bytes is the endpoint sample, not whole-workload peak. Direct proxy/client RSS unavailable.
